introduction: Nebraska’s earned income credit is claimed on the income-tax return. The 2025 Form 1040N includes the state credit calculation tied to the federal EITC.
description: Nebraska’s earned income credit is claimed on the income-tax return. The 2025 Form 1040N includes the state credit calculation tied to the federal EITC.

sections.who: Federal EITC eligibility and Nebraska return circumstances determine the claim. Nonresident, part-year or net-operating-loss situations can require additional calculation under the state instructions.
sections.get: The 2025 return starts with 10% of the federal credit. Use the state instructions for any adjustment and refund computation; it is not a separate monthly-assistance application.
sections.docs:
• Your federal return and federal EITC calculation.
  • Nebraska income and residence information for the return year.
  • Dependent records and any schedule relevant to part-year, nonresident or loss circumstances.
sections.apply:
1. Get the year-specific return

    Use the Nebraska forms directory.

  2. Complete the credit line

    For tax year 2025, follow Form 1040N line 44 and the instructions. Use the special worksheet when directed.

  3. File and retain records

    Submit the state return with required schedules and keep the calculation and confirmation.
sections.after: Read Revenue notices and ask a tax preparer about any adjustment to the federal credit. Do not reuse a prior year’s form for a new claim.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using 2025 Nebraska Form 1040N, 2025 individual tax instructions, Tax forms directory. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Where is the credit claimed for 2025?
On Form 1040N, line 44, following the state instructions.
Is there an application through iServe?
No. This credit is claimed through the tax return.
What if I have a net operating loss?
The state booklet includes a specific earned-income worksheet; follow it or get tax-preparation help.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
